items.description:
The Pantry Plumstead is a bakery and quick-counter cafe on the corner of Wicklow and Gabriel Road, which opened on 1 November 2023 as the brand's latest branch alongside its Tokai and Bergvliet locations. Baked goods are delivered twice a day from the group's bakery, including croissants, pastries, pies, muffins and cakes.

Sandwiches, burgers and wraps are prepared to order at the counter, and the cafe is known for its focus on artisan baked goods, good coffee and free WiFi for customers who want to sit and work. It suits Plumstead locals who want fresh bakery items delivered daily, or a quick sandwich and coffee on the go.

The Walden Suites is a nine-room guest house on the slopes of Lion's Head in Fresnaye, about a ten-minute walk down the hill from the Sea Point Promenade. Rooms range from sea-view suites with balconies and full views of Table Bay, the Atlantic and Robben Island, to rooms that open onto the pool terrace, and cooler, quieter mountain-view rooms at the back.

The largest suite, the Suite Balcony Sea View, sleeps two to four guests and shares its balcony with two other sea-facing rooms, making it a popular choice for honeymooners. The Suite Terrace Sea View offers a two-room layout with a lounge, open fireplace and corner sofa, while the Comfort Terrace Sea View gives direct access to the pool and garden.

Breakfast is a leisurely affair served in the courtyard from 8am to 10am, with a continental buffet, eggs and omelettes made to order, and fresh breads and pastries baked that morning. It suits couples and travellers who want a quiet, view-filled guest house close to the Sea Point Promenade.

items.description:
Transcape Steels is a steel merchant in Goodwood, Epping, trading since 1959 and recognised as a significant player in South and Southern African steel marketing and trading. The company describes nearly 60 years of experience, in-depth knowledge and a proven record of service excellence.

Its product range includes all sections and plates, bright steel shafting, cold-form sections, cold-rolled sheets, expanded metal, special steels and tubing, supplied to meet client specifications. The company serves the construction, engineering, manufacturing, mining, marine and agricultural sectors.

Its view all products section lets customers browse the full catalogue before contacting the Goodwood office directly for a quote.

It suits businesses across these industries that need specialised steel products sourced from an established regional supplier.

items.description:
Charly's Bakery is a family-run cake and cupcake bakery in District Six, started in 1989 and known for elaborate, custom-designed celebration cakes. The bakery's range covers deli cakes, kids' cakes, cupcakes, mini and large lunchbox cakes, wedding cakes, vegan options, cookies and deli counter items.

The bakery takes custom cake orders for any occasion, inviting customers to send through their ideas no matter how imaginative. Over the decades the business has grown from its original founding family into a wider team who continue to create colourful, detailed designer cakes.

It suits anyone planning a birthday, wedding or other celebration who wants a custom cake made to their own design, as well as walk-in customers after cupcakes or deli treats.

Henri's Restaurant and Wine Bar is set in a heritage house on Somerset West Main Road, open daily from midday till late, with earlier closing on Sunday evenings. The restaurant describes its menu as comfort food with a modern global influence, and it is particularly known for its aged, grass-fed beef and the freshest local seafood.

Alongside the a la carte menu, Henri's offers a light lunch menu during the day and a children's menu, along with homemade, thin-based pizzas cooked in a wood-fired oven. The top floor has been renovated for private functions, and larger groups are welcome, while the bar and patio offer a wide selection of craft and imported beers and wine by the glass.

It suits diners who want a casually sophisticated meal, a private function space, or a relaxed drink on the patio in Somerset West.

Hood Road Medical Centre is a community-based medical centre in Sunnyside, Crawford, which opened more than 12 years ago to serve Sunnyside, Belgravia, Crawford, Rondebosch East, Rylands and the greater Southern Suburbs. The centre brings together a general practitioner, a dentist, a psychologist, a speech therapist and an occupational therapist under one roof.

Each discipline has its own direct contact number, so patients can call the relevant practitioner to book an appointment rather than going through a single switchboard. The centre is based at 1 Hood Road, on the corner of Hood and Belgravia Roads.

It suits families in the surrounding Southern Suburbs who want access to several healthcare disciplines at one community medical centre.

items.description:
SA Metal Group is a scrap metal recycler at 14 Christian Avenue in Epping, committed to preserving the environment through its recovery processes. The company's state-of-the-art equipment recovers valuable metals from industrial waste that would otherwise be pollutants, producing recycled industrial and consumer products rather than relying on burning or chemical pollution.

The business collects and processes all forms of both ferrous and non-ferrous scrap metal. Some of the cleaned, prepared scrap is sold on to local smelters for further processing, some is consumed in the group's own smelting, alloying and casting operations, and the remainder is exported around the world.

It suits businesses and individuals in Cape Town who want to sell scrap metal to an established, environmentally conscious recycler.

Table Seven is an event catering and dining business based in the Salt Orchard development in Salt River, offering everything from daily blackboard lunches to an elegant Chef's Table experience. The team caters for weddings, corporate functions, events and private dining experiences, tailoring each menu to the client's tastes, preferences and budget at any venue.

The business says its vision is to use only the best quality seasonal ingredients from local suppliers, with a focus on exceptional service, produce and skill. Its lead chef brings more than 14 years of experience working in some of the world's top restaurants and hotels, with awards recognising that body of work.

It suits hosts planning a wedding, corporate event or private dining experience who want a tailored menu built around seasonal, locally sourced ingredients.

Zeitz MOCAA is a museum of contemporary art at the V&A Waterfront, running a changing programme of exhibitions alongside its collection. Current and upcoming shows span several years, including an online publication project, a publishing atelier, and exhibitions such as 'The Procession', 'Afflict the Comfortable, Comfort the Afflicted', 'Were It Not for Shadows', 'A Protea Is Not a Flower' and 'We Proceed in the Footsteps of the Sunlight'.

The museum also runs a what's on programme beyond its galleries, including film screenings through its Pan-African Film Caravan, which has shown works such as Sarah Maldoror's 'Sambizanga'. Visitors can plan a visit, become a member, or support the museum's mission through the Africa First initiative or direct donations, and the museum runs a BMW Centre for Art Education for collaborative and learning programmes.

It suits art lovers who want to see contemporary African art exhibitions and film programming at the Waterfront.

Belvedere Folly is a guest accommodation set in a Victorian colonial building in Oranjezicht, built in 1905 with lofty, intricately patterned pressed tinplate ceilings and typical bay windows. The facade was reimagined in the 1920s, when a broad, welcoming verandah and a first-floor terrace replaced the original narrow balcony, opening up glorious furnished spaces on both floors.

The interior living areas are spacious, warm and welcoming for guest use, while the terrace and verandah are shared communal spaces with views across the historic Molteno Reservoir to the city below. A front garden surrounds a small plunge pool with an elaborate gazebo, and sun loungers and umbrellas are available for guests who want to relax outdoors.

It suits guests who want characterful, historic accommodation within walking distance of Cape Town's city centre.

Cannings is a third-generation, family-run motor body repair shop in Cape Town's city centre area, established in 1973 with a vision to create a best-in-class panel and spray-painting business. The business has grown from strength to strength over the decades while remaining true to its original values of quality and customer satisfaction.

The team balances traditional values with modern repair techniques, pushing the boundaries of available technology to ensure each vehicle is restored to its original condition. Cannings works with a range of manufacturer-approved partners to help maintain its repair standards.

It suits motorists in the Cape Town area who want a long-established, family-run panel beating and spray painting shop with manufacturer-approved repair standards.

Chinchilla is a rooftop cocktail bar on the second floor of The Promenade Building on Victoria Road in Camps Bay, overlooking the strip with views of the sun setting over the Atlantic. The bar describes itself as one of Cape Town's best spots for a sundowner, serving impeccably crafted cocktails alongside an extensive wine and whisky selection.

The continental food menu includes sushi, seafood platters and crudités, and live DJs play at sunset during the bar's sunset sessions. No under-18s are allowed on the premises after 4pm.

It suits visitors who want a sundowner with sunset views and a DJ-led atmosphere above the Camps Bay strip.

items.description:
Holly Wood Kitchens and Furniture is a kitchen design and furniture business based in Retreat, offering custom kitchens alongside a wide range of handcrafted furniture. Its furniture lines cover bathroom furniture, pantry and bedroom cupboards, display and drinks cupboards, mudrooms, butchers' blocks, seating and dining pieces, ottomans, headboards, a kids' collection and luxury marble vanities.

The business has completed kitchens in a range of styles, from classic and modern Shaker designs with curved oak islands to simple Shaker kitchens finished with vibrant colour and antique brass handles, and timeless Shaker kitchens in soft, harmonious colour palettes. Full home renovation projects are also managed by the team's designers.

It suits homeowners across Cape Town who want a custom-designed kitchen or handcrafted furniture piece built to their own specification.

items.description:
The Clothing Bank is a multi-award-winning social enterprise in Thornton that marked ten years of operation by having revived 10 million items of clothing waste, worth an estimated R600 million. Over that period the organisation says it has touched the lives of more than 3,000 previously unemployed mothers and over 200 men.

The enterprise works at the intersection of clothing waste, most of which otherwise heads to landfill, and the challenge faced by single-parent households that rely on state grants to get by. It offers income-generating opportunities through a two-year training programme, giving participants skills and a nurturing environment in which to rebuild their working lives.

It suits donors and supporters who want to back a social enterprise that turns clothing waste into training and income for unemployed parents.

items.description:
The Cape Town Market is a commission-based fresh produce market in Epping, regulated by statute, where the commission charged is set at 12.5% on produce except for potatoes, which attract a lower rate. The market describes itself as operating under tighter regulation than its competitors, none of which are regulated in the same way.

The market serves both suppliers bringing produce to sell and buyers sourcing fresh produce, with agents on hand to assist with transactions, and it publishes daily prices for the produce traded through it. A dedicated hotline operates on weekday mornings and afternoons for enquiries.

It suits fresh produce suppliers and buyers in the Cape Town area who want to trade through a regulated commission market rather than an unregulated alternative.

Garden Court Nelson Mandela Boulevard is a 292-room hotel in Cape Town's Woodstock neighbourhood, less than ten minutes from the City Bowl and the V&A Waterfront and about 15 minutes from the airport. Rooms are fitted with free uncapped WiFi, air conditioning, DStv, a choice of bed configurations for solo, family or group travel, and views of Signal Hill or the harbour.

Guests can book Room Only or Bed and Breakfast rates, with breakfast included on the latter, and up to two children under 18 stay free when sharing with adults. The hotel's Harbour View restaurant offers buffet dining, and guests can cool off in the pool and garden between exploring the city.

It suits business and leisure travellers who want a well-located, mid-range hotel within easy reach of the City Bowl and the Waterfront.

items.description:
Mitchell's Scottish Ale House was the very first tenant of the V&A Waterfront and has served generations of locals and tourists since, opening daily from 9am for breakfast through to late at night. The pub is passionate about all things Scottish, running whisky tastings at its own Mitchell's School of Whisky and serving its namesake 'water of life', uisge-beatha.

The venue runs a Formula 1 Club offering an atmosphere, prizes and drink specials on race days, and a Liverpool Supporters Club giving members access to drink specials and prize giveaways. The bar stocks a wide range of beers, including some unusual choices alongside the regulars, served ice cold.

It suits sports fans and visitors who want harbour and mountain views with their beer, from an early breakfast through to a late night out.

Pisces Divers is a scuba diving operator and shop in Simon's Town, stocking a full rental range of regulators, BCDs, wet suits, fins, cylinders and dive computers for customers who have forgotten or do not own their own gear. Equipment is replaced every one to two years and serviced every six months to keep each dive running smoothly, and customers can try demo gear before buying.

The shop runs its own air and nitrox filling station, built around a Bauer Verticus Silent compressor delivering 600 litres a minute, with a bank of cylinders for bulk air storage. All air fills are double filtered through a Bauer P-61 filter system, with air quality tested regularly, and the shop supplies 100% pure medical oxygen to Cape Medical Response and other institutions and technical divers around the Cape Peninsula.

It suits certified divers who need rental gear or air and nitrox fills, as well as those wanting to try new equipment before buying it.

items.description:
Belly of the Beast is a 24-seat restaurant on Harrington Street in District Six, built around a tasting menu that has no set dishes or fixed number of courses. The kitchen serves some of the best cuts of sustainably sourced meat in the city, inspired by South African braai, with past highlights including antelope tataki and Saldanha Bay mussels with oyster emulsion and spicy vierge sauce.

Despite its meat-led concept, the restaurant will happily cater to vegetarians and pescatarians, as long as diners give advance notice when booking. The small size of the space makes it well suited to special occasions and unique dining experiences rather than a casual, spontaneous meal.

It suits diners looking for an experimental, surprise-driven tasting menu built around South African braai traditions, ideally booked ahead for a special occasion.

De Waterkant Place is a boutique guesthouse on Dixon Street in De Waterkant, a short walk from the V&A Waterfront, the CBD and Green Point. The guesthouse offers seven individually decorated rooms, with names such as The Regal Retreat, The Urban Oasis, The Skyline Suite and The Executive Suite, each with mountain or city views.

Guests get fast, free WiFi, daily cleaning and warm local hospitality, and the guesthouse is a short walk from the Cape Quarter Lifestyle Village, coffee shops and art galleries along De Waterkant's historic cobbled streets. The neighbourhood itself blends heritage buildings with modern cafes, boutique restaurants and design stores.

It suits business and leisure travellers who want a central, individually decorated guesthouse within walking distance of the Waterfront and De Waterkant's cafes and galleries.

items.description:
La Grange Interiors is a luxury furniture and interior decor showroom at the Woodstock Quarter on Sir Lowry Road, alongside a second showroom in Kramerville, Johannesburg. The Cape Town showroom stocks dining chairs, wooden and upholstered lounge chairs, rattan lounge and occasional chairs, cupboards, bookcases and shelving, desks, servers and chests of drawers, sofas and daybeds, and a range of coffee, side and bedside tables.

The Woodstock showroom trades on weekdays and Saturday mornings, with public holidays available by appointment only, and the business closes over Christmas and Easter. Customers can reach the Cape Town team directly by phone or email for furniture and interior decor enquiries.

It suits homeowners and interior designers who want to see a wide range of luxury furniture in person at the Woodstock Quarter.

items.description:
Pahari African Restaurant in Salt River takes its name from the Shona word for 'a place of pots', built around traditional African cooking methods using clay pots over an open fire. The kitchen aims to recreate recipes that have otherwise disappeared with time, as the skills to make them passed with the elders who once held them.

The restaurant's signature dish is based on sadza, also known as pap, made from maize and sometimes supplemented with rapoko finger millet or brown rice. Sadza is served with a choice of relishes, including beef stew, ox trotters, tripe with offal, free-range chicken and the Zimbabwean delicacy of Mopane worms, alongside green vegetables served fried or in peanut butter.

The restaurant also runs cooking classes and offers gift vouchers. It suits diners who want an authentic African dining experience built around traditional pot-cooked dishes, available for delivery as well as sit-down meals.

items.description:
Eziko Restaurant is a township restaurant in Langa paired with the Eziko Cooking and Catering School, with the name meaning 'hearth' in Xhosa, the heart of a home where family and friends gather. The school trains unemployed people in cooking, catering and hospitality skills, while the adjoining restaurant gives students first-hand experience of working in the catering industry.

Beyond its dining room, Eziko supplies coffee shops and catering companies around Cape Town with premium, freshly prepared goods made at the school. Visitors can choose a meal or simply a coffee, and either way they help support the training programme behind the restaurant.

It suits visitors who want a township dining experience that doubles as support for a hospitality training programme in Langa.

items.description:
Carole Nevin Design is a textile and homeware studio based on Eastlake Drive in Marina da Gama, Muizenberg, selling fabric by the metre alongside finished home textiles. Its ranges include the Venezia fabric collection and the Fynbos Garden collection, which extends into table linen and cushion or pillow covers inspired by the same fynbos designs.

Other lines include African Safari tea towels and prints such as Fynbos Garden Blues, Guinea Fowl, and Pincushion Trellis and Sugarbird, each drawing on South African plant and wildlife motifs. The studio also takes on bespoke orders and collaborations for customers who want a custom textile piece.

It suits homeowners and gift buyers who want South African, nature-inspired textiles, whether by the metre or as finished table and cushion linen.

items.description:
Lelapa Restaurant, meaning 'the home' in isiXhosa, has served township cuisine in Langa, Cape Town's oldest township, since it was established in October 1999 inside a converted family home. The idea grew out of watching tourist buses drive past the township on their way to the winelands, with the aim of inviting visitors in to experience township life over a meal.

The restaurant specialises in traditional township dishes made with fresh local ingredients, served buffet-style, with examples including carrots gently braised in lemon and herbs, sweet potatoes baked in a caramelised mustard-seed sauce, and an ostrich stroganoff marinated with coriander, chilli and salt and cooked with sweet peppers in a tangy sauce. Visitors have described the combination of food, music and culture as a memorable, authentic experience.

The restaurant is open by reservation only, and it suits visitors who want a genuine taste of township cuisine alongside the story of the area.

Ndwamba Market is Nyanga East's first supermarket, upgraded through a spaza shop modernisation programme run in partnership between Pick n Pay, the Old Mutual Foundation, the Masisizane Fund, Brimstone, the Western Cape Department of Economic Development and Tourism, and the City of Cape Town. What began as a small family spaza shop now has modern, top-of-the-range scanners at the till points and aisles fully stocked with everything from boerewors to baking powder.

The store serves hundreds of shoppers who walk its aisles each day, a marked change from its earlier, more basic set-up. It is one of two Western Cape stores upgraded under the same partnership programme.

It suits Nyanga East residents who want a well-stocked, modernised local supermarket rather than a small informal shop.

Two Oceans Aquarium is an aquarium at Dock Road in the V&A Waterfront, open 365 days a year and home to more than 8,000 animals from South Africa's oceans. Visitors can explore the exhibits, join feeding times and shows, or take a behind-the-scenes guided tour to learn how the aquarium's life support systems work and how its animals are cared for.

The aquarium's Penguin Experience lets visitors get up close with its northern rockhopper penguins in an educational, interactive session. Its Dive School is a certified PADI Five-Star Dive Centre and PADI Freediver Centre, offering shore and boat dives, snorkelling experiences and the chance to dive inside the aquarium itself.

An annual membership gives unlimited visits, making it suited to sea-loving families who want to return often, as well as first-time visitors and new divers.

Living Hope runs a Health Care Centre in Capri Village offering a 22-bed sub-acute hospital, providing step-down care for patients who have suffered an acute illness, injury or disease and no longer need intensive diagnostic or invasive procedures. The centre began as an in-patient palliative care hospice for people with terminal illnesses before shifting its function to match the community's changing needs.

Care is provided around the clock by an interdisciplinary team that includes a medical doctor, a social worker, a physiotherapist, an occupational therapist, a chaplain, professional nurses and carers. Patients are referred by a clinic or hospital, or identified by the organisation's own Home Based Care team, with the referring doctor completing an admission application before medical aid authorisation is arranged.

Beyond healthcare, Living Hope also runs agricultural training, substance abuse recovery, life skills, skills development and family strengthening programmes. It suits patients needing step-down nursing care after a hospital stay, and the referring clinics and hospitals that work with the organisation.

Organic Zone is an organic supermarket at the corner of Main and Putter Roads in Lakeside, describing itself as a one-stop organic shop for fresh, seasonal, local and organic produce. The store stocks a large selection of nutrient-dense, additive-free and preservative-free wholefoods, alongside items such as olive oil, honey and corn chips from South African organic producers.

The business says it has cultivated long-standing, supportive relationships with its organic farmers over many years, supporting Western Cape growers and sustainable sourcing practices. Customers describe the fridge and fresh vegetable sections as well stocked, with an in-store barista serving coffee and ample free parking outside.

It suits shoppers looking for organic groceries, toiletries and hard-to-find health products in one store, whether shopping online or in person.

BPM Toolcraft is a hardware and tool shop at 95 Victoria Road in Southfield, part of the Plumstead area, offering what it describes as the largest range of quality power tools, fine hand tools, and stationary woodworking machinery and accessories in stock and on display in South Africa. The shop trades under the Toolcraft brand and is based in Cape Town.

Customers can view the full range in store, with items on display rather than only available to order. The shop trades on weekdays and is closed over the weekend.

It suits tradespeople and woodworking enthusiasts who want to see a large range of power and hand tools in person before buying.
